Use case: stylized-concept. Single transparent game-map prop for the Japanese fantasy party board game NO MONEY, NO LIFE. Unified art direction with the existing royal castle: charming rounded chibi RPG toy-like architectural/object volume, 2D hand-painted clean cel shading, crisp warm outlines, saturated but tasteful colors, broad readable details, not photorealistic, not gritty, no excessive tiny texture. FIXED CAMERA for the entire asset set: orthographic front-facing view, looking down from 35–40 degrees above the ground, visible top surfaces and tall front faces, depth recedes toward top of frame, width axis mostly horizontal. Not eye-level, not top-down, NOT 45-degree diamond isometric. Light from upper left, short subtle contact shadow to lower right restricted to immediate footprint. Complete object centered with transparent margins, no cropping. Genuine alpha-transparent background, including all corners; no solid background, no checkerboard painted in, no surrounding scenery, no horizon, no glow haze filling the canvas, no studio floor, no floating pedestal or display base, no labels or text, no characters, no watermarks. One isolated reusable map prop.
SUBJECT: A welcoming adventurers' guild hall, substantial cream-stone and timber building with a few rounded teal-blue gabled roofs, a prominent broad arched entrance facing bottom of image, a simple shield-and-crossed-swords emblem with NO lettering, modest gold metal details and warm windows. Compact coherent building, a little entry step only, no surrounding town, no market stalls. Make the front door and roof shape readable from afar.
